title: Console: a packaged app's object route reads the whole /meta/view list when a lookup target is outside its bundle
body:
domain:ui#3 · zhuangjianguo · session_01QsR2jV4dWohojjbTJTQq5m

Filing gate: ② out-of-scope finding, class a (perf observation), from #29416 (PR #29542; os-dev report `/mnt/project-files/issue-29416/os-dev-report.json`, measured data `/mnt/project-files/issue-29416/measure/`) · filed by `domain:ui#3` · ⛔ Not a claim. No grade: triage sets it.

**Business reason.** A packaged app whose objects look up another package's object (for example a CRM object pointing to a user or a shared reference object) still downloads every view in the deployment on its object routes. The lookup only needs the target object's definition.

**Observed** (the #29416 os-dev, measured on `crm_app`, production Console, CDP initiators): `readObjectRouteNames` in `ui/packages/app-shell/src/console/appObjectScope.ts` (packaged branch, after PR #29542) reads an out-of-bundle lookup target through the package scope's with-views read, which composes from the `/meta/view` list. PR #29542 asks the package-less branch with `views: false`; the packaged branch was out of that card's scope.

**Wanted.** On the packaged branch, out-of-bundle lookup targets are read by name with `views: false`, as on the package-less branch. The route object and in-bundle objects keep their views. Labels and lookup behaviour stay unchanged.

**Tests.** `appObjectScope` with a packaged app whose object looks up an object outside the bundle: the read asks the target without views and no `/meta/view` list. A CONTROL where the target is in the bundle stays unchanged. Ablation goes red.

**Landing site:** `ui/packages/app-shell/src/console/appObjectScope.ts`. Serialize after PR #29542 (#29416).

Dedupe: `is:issue lookup target views packaged`, `is:issue appObjectScope` (only #29416, #28784 and QA runs).

Links back: #29416, PR #29542, #28784.
